dedupe_keys.name: prep geospatial processing and mobile coverage layers for electoral analysis in mexico

description: Instituto Politécnico Nacional researchers publish processed mobile-coverage layers and polling-station links for Mexico’s 2023–2024 federal election. The June 2026 Zenodo release supplies coverage archives, a QGIS project and Excel tables under CC BY 4.0, free to download. Its README identifies second-quarter 2024 IFT coverage data for 3G, 4G and 5G, joined to INE locations and PREP records through normalised territorial identifiers and unique polling-station keys. Geometry correction and unmatched-record handling are documented. These layers can inform spatial connectivity and service-access assumptions in communication-infrastructure simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this processed combination. Claimed coverage is not a field throughput measurement; geographic completeness and join accuracy were not independently checked. The README names GeoPackage layers, but whether the QGIS project embeds every dependency remains unknown. Users must retain institutional-source attribution. No spatial files or spreadsheets were downloaded.
